creators.name: Emily Pentecost (@thingsivebeeneating) — Ohio food & travel creator whose Dayton reels go viral
creators.credible: Cleveland-based Ohio food+travel creator; her Val's Bakery reel hit ~2.5M views and drove a documented 500% traffic spike (per WDTN). Findable Dayton videos at named places: Culture (video 7414662934174928171), Koji Burger (video 7413452663330835755).

creators.name: Gideon General (@gidsgids) — Dayton Fil-Am chef & recipe creator
creators.credible: 1.3M TikTok followers; Centerville HS + Sinclair Community College Culinary grad; dedicated 'goes viral' features in Dayton Daily News and WDTN; brand work with Pepsi, NFL, Samsung, Walmart, KFC; covered by Buzzfeed and Manila Bulletin. Recipe creator (not a place reviewer).

creators.name: Kait Lott (@kaitskravings) — Cincinnati/Ohio travel foodie
creators.credible: ~38K Instagram; profiled by Cincinnati Magazine ('Kait Lott Knows What You Crave'); Midwest/Ohio travel-foodie track record. Findable Dayton content at a named place: Tender Mercy ('Don't Sleep on Dayton', video 7165589419142171950).

creators.name: Andrew Walsh (Dayton Vistas) — Dayton history, architecture & preservation author
creators.followers: Published author + YouTube channel + Dayton Vistas Podcast + IG @daytonvistas
creators.credible: Authoritative local historian: author of 'Lost Dayton, Ohio' (The History Press, 2018); academic librarian; runs Dayton Vistas (blog, YouTube, podcast) covering Dayton architecture and redevelopment; gives public talks and walking tours; documented press/media appearances. Qualifies on authority.

creators.name: Lauren Rinehart (Girl About Dayton) — Dayton lifestyle & food blogger
creators.credible: Longest-running Dayton lifestyle blog (started 2011); weekly newsletter; Dayton-native marketing pro; profiled by Voyage Ohio Magazine; publishes dedicated first-person food posts at named Dayton places (e.g., Wheat Penny).

creators.name: Simba Muhammad II (@DaSliderGuy) — Dayton social-media chef
creators.followers: Viral per DDN/WDTN; full-time across TikTok/YouTube/IG/FB (exact count not surfaced via search)
creators.credible: Dayton Daily News and WDTN both ran dedicated features documenting his viral rise ('Dayton content creator goes viral on TikTok'; 'Dayton chef goes viral by sharing recipes'); full-time creator; Voyage Ohio 'Rising Stars' profile. Popularity is third-party-documented even though a scraped follower number was not surfaced. Recipe/comfort-food creator (not a place reviewer).
